verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal, and the docs show it ships `grep`, a regex-capable text search and filter command, though only in the context of filtering the command list. It also bundles Vim for navigating files. There is no explicit evidence of searching code content, and nothing at all on fuzzy matching. Missing for 10: fuzzy matching/finder tool, documented regex code search across files (e.g., grep -r/ripgrep), search filters by file type or path, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and navigate code content using fuzzy matching, filters, and regular expressions

citations.quote: `help -l | grep command` will tell you if your favorite command is already installed.
a-Shell comes with Vim included. You can edit your files
The goal in this project is to provide a simple Unix-like terminal on iOS.
